items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: He's the one who picked Cazin.

ctx.x: I was about 13 years old. You was 13 years old. I was playing at the college in the Rubin or Clarence. Yeah, remember that? Yeah, remember that? Yeah, I got around so close. Who's talking about Henry Cazin? Not Henry Cazin, though.
Henry Julian. They did. No, Henry Cazin.
He's the one who picked Cazin.
